Lena M.: Heads-up: final run for next week's benchmarks webinar at 10am PT. greenroom 30m before. can ops confirm recording + captions export path?
Dev S.: Confirmed. Cloud recording enabled. We'll also run a simultaneous local host capture. transcript + captions -> S3 in folder /webinars/2026-04-15/benchmarks/ with public-read=false.
Arjun K.: Reg page tweak: change main CTA from 'Register' to 'Save my seat — benchmarks & live demo' (keeps benefit + urgency). also want a second micro-CTA under hero: 'See sample results' linking to a small static image.
Lena M.: Love it. Can you shorten the confirmation email subject to 'Thanks — replay & benchmark snapshot' if CTA goes live?
Dev S.: Yep. I'll atomically update the redirect so confirmation page has utm_source=webinar_apr2026&utm_medium=registration. HubSpot list name we should use?
Arjun K.: Use hubspot list 'wb_apr2026_benchmarks'. add property: interest=benchmarks_demo and initial_touch=webinar_landing. tag leads for follow-up cadence A/B.
Clara (Legal): Reminder: include cookie/consent notice on registration redirect and explicit opt-in checkbox for marketing follow-ups. no screenshots of customers without signed release.
Dev S.: Ops checklist I'm running now:
```
Zoom: cloud_recording=on
Auto_transcription=on
Record_separate_files=on
Local_backup=/var/backups/zoom/2026-04-15
S3_export=enabled (bucket: redwood-webinar-exports, path: /webinars/2026-04-15/benchmarks)
Caption_export_formats=[.vtt, .srt]
```
Dev S.: ops-bot will post S3 path when export completes. also enabling 'allow participants to save chat' for Q&A export.
Lena M.: Post-event delivery timeline (tentative):
- T+10m: short replay email with link to edited highlight (2-3min) + CTA for trial credits
- T+18h: full replay + TL;DR + benchmark snapshot image for social
- T+72h: segmented nurture: bench leads -> SDR outreach, general leads -> newsletter track
Arjun K.: For the AB subject lines i'll test: a) 'Replay + benchmark snapshot' b) 'Watch the live demo & metrics' c) 'Quick highlights: latency & cost'
Clara (Legal): Also please ensure replay email footer includes: privacy policy link, contact for removal, and 'we may follow up with relevant product info if you opted in.'
ops-bot: Cloud recording started at 3345551276 — file pending export.
Dev S.: When S3 export completes i'll post the exact object names. Mike from content will pull captions for subtitle burn-in.
Lena M.: Owners: Landing page & emails -> Arjun, Editing & clips -> Mike (cc'd), Ops/recording -> Dev, Legal compliance -> Clara. everyone OK?
Arjun K.: All good here. i'll push the landing copy shortly and tag QA.
Lena M.: Great — last preflight in 20. see greenroom then. :sparkles:
